thread:
alex: Heads-up — rolling ramp for ff/trust-model at 10:30 is spiking 502s in canary (~4% error rate). Can we pause the ramp?

deploy-bot: Canary rollout started for release/2026-03-20 (canary=5%).

alex: @sam @ingrid seeing errors across seq-length 2048 requests. Not memory OOMs, upstream 500s.

sam: Rolling back canary variant now. plan: drain traffic back to stable, pin model v2.1.1 -> v2.1.0, abort FF ramp.

ingrid: On it. I'll cut the flag to 0% in the routing service and pin behind /generate route.

maria: tagging infra — will watch GPU utilization. Also setting circuit-breaker threshold to 1% error for the route.

ops-bot: Alert created: 5xx-rate higher than baseline on canary nodes. PagerDuty notified.

sam: Command I'll run:
```
/ff toggle ff/trust-model 0 --env prod --reason "emergency drain"
```

sam: Then pin route:
```
/route pin /generate model=v2.1.0 --env prod --reason "canary rollback"
```

alex: Also add a holdpoint: do not resume ramp until error <0.5% for 15m and deploy-monitoring OK. Notify #eng-releases before any resume.

ingrid: Copying runbook steps to thread. Opening a rollback ticket and annotating the release notes with the abort reason.

maria: I'll coordinate a short postmortem and capture relevant logs. For now leaving canary nodes up for debugging — no traffic.

deploy-bot: Canary rollback completed, traffic shifted to stable. Rollout status: aborted.

sam: Confirmed 5xx rate back to baseline. Monitoring alarms cleared and circuit-breaker remains.

alex: Thanks team. We'll re-run a much smaller smoke canary later with conservative ramp (1% -> 2% -> 5%) and stricter perf gates.

maria: Scheduling a 30m post-deploy review at 11:15 in #eng-releases, will post notes and checklist.

ingrid: Leaving a note: suspected regression from tokenization patch in model v2.1.1 — adding to CI tests and model-onboard checklist.

sam: Also added ff guard in deploy pipeline: require perf-gate pass before any >1% ramp.

alex: :thumbsup:
